summary:
Time Flies: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an educational 2D point-and-click
survival escape room game designed for students ages 10–15. Set on Mars, the game
challenges players to survive as Emher, an astronaut stranded after an emergency
spacecraft landing. Players must deploy a survival pod, manage limited power
resources, gather essential materials, and repair the damaged spacecraft before an
approaching mega-sandstorm strikes. Incorporating real Martian environmental data
from NASA's Curiosity REMS and Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter datasets, the game
provides an interactive learning experience that introduces space science, resource
management, engineering decisions, and mission protocols. Through its survival
mechanics and time-loop narrative, Time Flies emphasizes the importance of
preparation, critical thinking, and collaboration in overcoming challenges.
details: Time Flies: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an educational 2D point-and-click survival escape room game designed for students ages 10–15. Set on Mars, the game challenges players to survive as Emher, an astronaut stranded after an emergency spacecraft landing. Players must deploy a survival pod, manage limited power resources, gather essential materials, and repair the damaged spacecraft before an approaching mega-sandstorm strikes. Incorporating real Martian environmental data from NASA's Curiosity REMS and Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter datasets, the game provides an interactive learning experience that introduces space science, resource management, engineering decisions, and mission protocols. Through its survival mechanics and time-loop narrative, Time Flies emphasizes the importance of preparation, critical thinking, and collaboration in overcoming challenges.
